References / App / 302

Podcasts app, 2012

Apple’s first standalone podcast app, whose player showed an animated reel-to-reel tape deck.

Source
The Next Web, Matthew Panzarino, 21 March 2013
Creator
Apple
Made
2012 (announced at WWDC 2012 as part of iOS 6); tape deck removed 21 March 2013
Style
Skeuomorphism (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Nostalgic, mechanical, playful
Evidence
No image was inspected. Based on The Next Web and Gizmodo reports of the March 2013 update, and on Wikipedia.
Reviewed
28 September 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

A standalone Apple Podcasts app was announced at WWDC 2012 as a feature of iOS 6. Wikipedia: Apple Podcasts.

In the update of 21 March 2013, “Gone are the fat tape-machine style buttons and the reel-to-reel imitation scrubber.” The Next Web.

Gizmodo reported the same change under the headline “Apple’s Podcasts App No Longer Has Horrible Reel-to-Reel Skeuomorphism.”

Why it belongs

The object had no link to how podcasts are made or delivered. It shows the style used as nostalgia, and its removal three months before iOS 7 marks the end of the period.

What to review next
